symptom: platform Setup(t) calls UpdateConfig before Start, so the cached client config and its hash stay stale until the next config change; the first change in a test then also flips EnableOpenServer and moves the hash.
check: read ClientConfig()/ClientConfigHash() as a baseline only after one real config change, never straight after Setup(t).

symptom: jsdom has no layout: every size, offset and scroll value is 0, so scroll and visibility logic looks broken.
check: stub sizes explicitly and assert only on values the stubs make meaningful.

symptom: go test -race can fail inside searchengine.Broker.UpdateConfig when unrelated tests mutate config concurrently.
check: do not drive concurrent UpdateConfig unless the PR changed UpdateConfig or removed locking around shared searchengine state.
